title: Oven Roasted Dutch Cheese Casserole
description: A romantic Dutch dish featuring saffron and smoked cheese, this casserole is perfect for a cozy night in, with a yeasty crust and a cheese-pull effect that is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, combine the yeast and warm milk, stirring to dissolve the yeast.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and pepper.
Add the yeast mixture, egg, and shredded cheese to the flour mixture, stirring until a dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch and place in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Drizzle the olive oil over the dough and sprinkle with saffron threads.
Bake the casserole for 25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
